Ham’s exalt does bleed equal to half of its physical damage on a target
But increases if the target has a debuff that isn’t destined omen (only debuff I can remember that can’t be dispelled)
Stagnation, bleed, entwined, etc. will all increase Ham’s bleed percentage from 50% to 100%
This does not stack (stagnation and entwined on a target will only increase the bleed percentage to 100%)
